meta.title: Một Ly Café & Matcha | Matcha & coffee in Go Vap
meta.description: A small café & matcha shop at 93 Tran Thi Nghi, Go Vap, Ho Chi Minh City. Matcha latte, salted cream matcha, coffee and pastries. Takeaway and delivery. Open daily 08:00 – 21:30.
meta.ogAlt: Một Ly Café & Matcha – matcha and coffee in Go Vap

hero.subtitle: Matcha made cup by cup, bold Vietnamese coffee and a few pastries on the side. Grab it to go, order on your delivery app, or stay a while at our little front-porch corner.

about.title: Small shop, carefully made cups
about.p1: Một Ly is a small café & matcha shop on Tran Thi Nghi Street in Go Vap. Matcha is our main thing: gently bitter, softly sweet and just creamy enough.
about.p2: We mostly serve takeaway and delivery, so it's easy to grab a cup on your way to school or work. If you're not in a hurry, take a seat at the little outdoor corner in front of the shop.
about.imageAlt: The Một Ly shopfront in Go Vap
